author: LunarKeyn
body:
Age: 17 years old

Timezone: UTC/GMT -5 hours

Do you have Teamspeak? Yes, I do

Do you have Discord? Yes, I do

Do you have access to a recording software? Yes, I have the "action" istalled



CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION


Do you have any experience as a moderator on other servers? Yes, and no at the same time, because, all the servers that I moderated, were little projects, the servers had 20-30 people per day, but, I never had problems with nobody.


What is your biggest weakness and how will it affect your moderating? The empathy, why?, I like to be a "friendly" person with people, so, I don't like to treat people badly, maybe that could interfere with my desicions.


What qualities do you think a leader must have? Would you consider yourself a leader? Why/why not? I think that a leader must to be the person who guides the others, he mustn't just order. I don't consider myself a leader, because, I see myself as any other person with whom I am speaking, I do not see myself with the ability to be able to guide people towards a good path, but to support them... yes


What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator? Reffering to minecraft, I think that I can understand the reason of why the people use hacks, , behave in a bad way, etc, BUT that doesn't give them the right to do it, if they disobey the rules, must be punished, thats the best way for peace.


What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills? Again, I am so friendly but, if i'm "cool" with players, I will not let myself be carried, and at the moment of exercising my authority I'll be impartial.


What in your opinion are the three main character traits a moderator must have when moderating?

-Impartial

-Clean-fingered

-friendly


CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS


You notice a moderator giving out a lot of false bans. They almost always have insufficient evidence or sometimes no evidence and they don’t seem to care. You notice it but other staff members don’t. What would you do? First, I will tell him that notice his mistake, that he isn't doing the things right, if he doesn't listen to me, I will contact another member of staff and I'll tell him what's happening.


You are in Teamspeak with a few other players and they begin talking quite disrespectfully about a particular staff member. You agree with what they’re saying to an extent, but the conversation starts to become racial and very disrespectful soon after. You are all in a nightclub channel where this is allowed. What would you do? If I am with they in the channel, that means they are my friends (It doesn't matter if they aren't), so, I will tell them that please be more compassionate with their words, or that they could talk about that in private


You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confidential but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do? Faster, I would tell him that remove that screenshot, because he could be punished for that, and if it't so confidential and if I can remove it by myself I would do it. And I will tell him the reason of my daring.



Some senior staff members are in teamspeak joking around with each other. They are removing others ranks, creating certain channels and even harassing certain users. They don’t mean any harm but some players in the channel feel a bit angry that they are using their permissions the way they are. What would you do? Mmm, the player must to do a report in the forum, so I could guide him to do that, and I'll tell them that they must control himselfs, the things that they are doing It's creating problems with the users so calm down please.



CRITERIA 3: OTHER

NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.



Why do you want to be a moderator? because I like this server and I know that I can bring so help, with two communities because I can speak spanish too.


What does Avicus mean to you? nowadays, it's the only server where I play minecraft so, It's a good way to have fun and socialize with other players who share my best hobby, play video games.


Anything specific the staff team could do better? Maybe just diffuse the server, but, I don't know if that's the job of the staff, so, the true is, that I want to more players play here :'D


Why did you choose to apply at Avicus? Because I have playing 3 years here, so, 

I want to contribute something more to the server, even if It's only a little


Do you have anything else to add to your application? I was so nervious writting this, but it was fun too, I'm so exiting, I'll not be angry if you don't choose me, because, I know that there are more people with more experience than me, thank you so much for read my application.
